import pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw

# Create a sample DataFrame
data = {"spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 800, 2000]}
df_native = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals and add tier column
df = nw.from_native(df_native)
df_with_tier = df.with_columns(
    nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
    .then("gold")
    .otherwise("standard")
    .alias("tier")
)

# Display result
print(nw.to_native(df_with_tier))
